draw: census: all 85 witnesses of census.json, in order
transcript: The proposal artifact is canonically serialized as JSON with recursively sorted keys and no whitespace, then persisted as proposal_canon.json. A third party recomputes hProposal = sha256(proposal_canon.json) = ba53bf67928c0c20e06c84764d645da60dec8fa3123517d250a60bb7619e4768. The seed is derived as seedHex = sha256(hProposal + salt) where salt = 6390d03fecec11c3ef89b33d3c09bc3eb37a9f511d660a4b6967b04d2a93f5f2, yielding 84432aebe42789909f3f834364f757a3d5bc8871f2869f69c8329896b01b84cb. The draw rule is census mode: all 85 witnesses from census.json are drawn in order, without replacement, deterministically seeded from the proposal artifact itself. No proposer choice, no prover influence — the witnesses are derived by the Gap alone from the proposal bytes.
